summary: Nam Tai Property Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its notice of 2026 annual meeting of shareholders and proxy materials. The meeting is scheduled for June 15, 2026, to elect six director nominees (all incumbent) and transact other business. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change is described. This is a routine annual meeting notice with standard director elections.
